# Driver stage

*Not yet started.* The driver stage covers the [PC-3A driver board](../../components/pc-3a-driver-board.md) wiring — the two [6GH8A tubes](../../components/6gh8a-driver-tube.md) (one per channel, in board-mounted 9-pin miniature sockets), their plate/screen/grid networks, and the wiring that connects this stage to the [EL34 output sockets](../../components/el34-output-tube.md).

Comes after the [power supply (page 6)](../power-supply/index.md) wiring is complete.
